arxiv-1802-04489.title: Unbalanced urn model with random addition
arxiv-1802-04489.creator: Rafik Aguech Nabil Lasmar, Olfa Selmi
arxiv-1802-04489.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Rafik Aguech Nabil Lasmar, Olfa Selmi. In this paper, we consider a multi-drawing urn model with random addition. At each discrete time step, we draw a sample of m m balls. According to the composition of the drawn colors, we return the balls together with a random number of balls depending on two discrete random variables X X and Y Y with finite means and variances. Via the stochastic approximation algorithm, we give limit theorems describing the asymptotic behavior of white balls.

arxiv-2212-13485.description: Abstract Short-range ordering in cation-disordered cathodes can have a significant effect on their electrochemical properties. Here, we characterise the cation short-range order in the antiperovskite cathode material Li 2 ​ FeSO \text{Li}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\vphantom{\text{2}}\smash[t]{\text{2}}}^{\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\hphantom{\text{2}}\text{}}\text{FeSO} , using density functional theory, Monte Carlo simulations, and synchrotron X-ray pair-distribution-function data.

arxiv-2303-14128.title: The crime of being poor
arxiv-2303-14128.creator: Georgina Curto, Svetlana Kiritchenko, Isar Nejadgholi, Kathleen C. Fraser
arxiv-2303-14128.description: Abstract The criminalization of poverty has been widely denounced as a collective bias against the most vulnerable. NGOs and international organizations claim that the poor are blamed for their situation, are more often associated with criminal offenses than the wealthy strata of society and even incur criminal offenses simply as a result of being poor.

arxiv-2309-08927.title: DynaMoN: Motion-Aware Fast and Robust Camera Localization for Dynamic Neural Radiance Fields
arxiv-2309-08927.creator: Nicolas Schischka, Hannah Schieber, Mert Asim Karaoglu, Melih Gorgulu, Florian Grötzner, Alexander Ladikos, Nassir Navab, Daniel Roth, Benjamin Busam
arxiv-2309-08927.description: Abstract The accurate reconstruction of dynamic scenes with neural radiance fields is significantly dependent on the estimation of camera poses. Widely used structure-from-motion pipelines encounter difficulties in accurately tracking the camera trajectory when faced with separate dynamics of the scene content and the camera movement.

arxiv-2405-01145.title: Localized RETE for Incremental Graph Queries Thanks: This preprint has not undergone peer review or any post-submission improvements or corrections. The Version of Record of this contribution is published in Graph Transformation, and is available online at https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-031-64285-2_7
arxiv-2405-01145.creator: Matthias Barkowsky, Holger Giese
arxiv-2405-01145.description: Abstract Context: The growing size of graph-based modeling artifacts in model-driven engineering calls for techniques that enable efficient execution of graph queries. Incremental approaches based on the RETE algorithm provide an adequate solution in many scenarios, but are generally designed to search for query results over the entire graph.

arxiv-2407-16491.title: Canadian Traveller Problems in Temporal Graphs
arxiv-2407-16491.creator: Thomas Bellitto, Johanne Cohen, Bruno Escoffier, Minh-Hang Nguyen, Mikaël Rabie
arxiv-2407-16491.description: Abstract We focus on the Canadian Traveller Problem, where a traveller aims to travel from s s to t t on a network with the minimum cost, with up to k k edges potentially blocked. These edges remain hidden until the traveller visits one of their endpoints.

arxiv-2409-09992.title: Neutrino theory: open questions and future opportunities
arxiv-2409-09992.creator: Raymond R. Volkas
arxiv-2409-09992.description: Abstract The subtitle of my talk is “The quest for understanding the origin of neutrino masses”. After reviewing why the discovery of neutrino masses is also the discovery of New Physics, the substance of the talk details mechanisms for generating Majorana neutrino masses and implications for experimental searches and/or cosmology.

arxiv-2410-18413.title: AC-Network-Informed DC Optimal Power Flow for Electricity Markets
arxiv-2410-18413.creator: Gonzalo E. Constante, André H. Quisaguano, Antonio J. Conejo, Can Li
arxiv-2410-18413.description: Abstract This paper presents a parametric quadratic approximation of the AC optimal power flow (AC-OPF) problem for time-sensitive and market-based applications. The parametric approximation preserves the physics-based but simple representation provided by the DC-OPF model and leverages market and physics information encoded in the data-driven demand-dependent parameters.

arxiv-2506-02586.title: Time path of turbulence and multi-fractality of magnetic field in the evolution of an active region
arxiv-2506-02586.creator: Valentina Abramenko
arxiv-2506-02586.description: Abstract keywords Active Regions, Magnetic fields; Magnetic fields, Photosphere; Turbulence; Instabilities \setlastpage \inarticletrue {opening} 1 Introduction The solar surface is thought to be a thin layer of several hundred kilometers, hosting sunspots (sunspot groups), which are visible as dark features on white-light images and surviving usually several weeks.

arxiv-2506-06609.title: Transferring Features Across Language Models With Model Stitching
arxiv-2506-06609.creator: Alan Chen, Jack Merullo, Alessandro Stolfo, Ellie Pavlick
arxiv-2506-06609.description: Abstract In this work, we demonstrate that affine mappings between residual streams of language models is a cheap way to effectively transfer represented features between models. We apply this technique to transfer the weights of Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) between models of different sizes to compare their representations.

arxiv-2507-04286.title: Omega-regular Verification and Control for Distributional Specifications in MDPs
arxiv-2507-04286.creator: S. Akshay, Ouldouz Neysari, Đorđe Žikelić
arxiv-2507-04286.description: Abstract A classical approach to studying Markov decision processes (MDPs) is to view them as state transformers. However, MDPs can also be viewed as distribution transformers, where an MDP under a strategy generates a sequence of probability distributions over MDP states.

arxiv-2601-12183.title: Maximum precision charging of multi-qubit quantum batteries
arxiv-2601-12183.creator: Davide Rinaldi, Radim Filip, Dario Gerace, Giacomo Guarnieri
arxiv-2601-12183.description: Abstract Precision, robustness, and efficiency are crucial aspects in the design of quantum technologies. Here, we show how genuine quantum features, together with non-Gaussianity, can be the key elements to achieve the best of these three aspects during a quantum battery-charging process. pmc-12052300.title: Hyperactivating EZH2 to augment H3K27me3 levels in regulatory T cells enhances immune suppression by driving early effector differentiation
pmc-12052300.creator: Janneke GC Peeters, Stephanie Silveria, Merve Ozdemir, Srinivas Ramachandran, Michel DuPage
pmc-12052300.description: SUMMARYThe immunosuppressive function of regulatory T (Treg) cells is essential for maintaining immune homeostasis. Enhancer of zeste homolog 2 (EZH2), a histone H3 lysine 27 (H3K27) methyltransferase, plays a key role in maintaining Treg cell function upon CD28 co-stimulation, and Ezh2 deletion in Treg cells causes autoimmunity.

pmc-12644860.title: New solutions of multidimensional fuzzy fractional coupled Burgers systems via He Laplace Carson algorithm
pmc-12644860.creator: Mubashir Qayyum, Sidra Nayab, Omar Khan, Jihad Younis, Abdou Al Zubaidi, Mazhar Hussain, Syed Tauseef Saeed
pmc-12644860.description: The coupled Burgers model, a system of nonlinear partial differential equations, is widely used to describe complex interactions in various fields, including fluid dynamics, traffic flow, and biological systems. It provides insights into phenomena such as shock waves, turbulence, pattern formation, and transitions from order to chaos.

pmc-12669344.title: Suizidprävention im Hamburger Strafvollzug – Analyse der Fälle 2013–2022 und Auswertung von Interviews mit Inhaftierten und Mitarbeitenden
pmc-12669344.creator: Sabrina Kunze, Celine Nguyen, Lena Harms, Carlotta Herrmann, Nadine Ritter, Klaus Püschel, Peer Briken, Benjamin Ondruschka
pmc-12669344.description: HintergrundSeit 1962 werden Suizidfälle im Hamburger Strafvollzug wissenschaftlich hinsichtlich Ursachen und Risikofaktoren analysiert, um Maßnahmen der Suizidprävention zu verbessern. Die vorliegende Arbeit knüpft daran an und untersucht die Suizide von 2013–2022. Ergänzend geben Interviews mit Inhaftierten und Mitarbeitenden Einblicke in Herausforderungen der Suizidprävention.MethodenDie Studie folgte einem Mixed-Methods-Ansatz. Für die Suizidfälle 2013–2022 wurden rechtsmedizinische Sektionsprotokolle sowie Gefangenen-Personalakten und -Gesundheitsakten quantitativ-deskriptiv ausgewertet.

pmc-13048258.title: The longevity effects of reduced IGF-1 signaling depend on the stability of the mitochondrial genome
pmc-13048258.creator: Sarah J. Shemtov, Eric McGann, Lucy Carrillo, Sangmin Lee, Herbert Anson, Eric Hwang, Claire S. Chung, Jaye L. Weinert, Maria-Eleni Anagnostou, Guan-Ju D. Lai, Bert M. Verheijen, Junxiang Wan, Ivetta Vorobyova, Monica Sanchez-Contreras, Cheryl A. Conover, Max A. Thorwald, Pinchas Cohen, Scott R. Ken
pmc-13048258.description: Suppression of insulin-like growth factor-1 (IGF-1) signaling extends mammalian life span and protects against a range of age-related diseases. Unexpectedly, we found that reduced IGF-1 signaling fails to extend the life span of mitochondrial mutator mice. Most of the longevity pathways that are normally initiated by IGF-1 suppression were either blocked or blunted in the mutator mice.

pmc-13428199.creator: Muhammad Nawaz Khan, Tehsina Ali, Muhammad Sohaib Khan, Syed Shayan Shah, Bilal Bashir, Ali Talha, Adnan Khan, Syed Jawad Ahmad, Muhammad Junaid, Amy Schwartz, RL Jeffree
pmc-13428199.description: BackgroundEmergency referral systems in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) are characterized by systemic inefficiencies, including prolonged transfer delays, interfacility miscommunication, and inadequate receiving-end preparation. In Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP), a province of Pakistan with a population exceeding 40 million, referral pathways remain predominantly paper-based and operationally fragmented.
